input_domain: Explicitly present decoded valid UTF-8 Text of0..1024 bytes. Arbitrary Go byte strings and longer inputs are outside this adaptation. Raw malformed JSON Unicode is a separate transport boundary.
type_and_algorithm_difference: Go lazybuf is replaced by bounded whole-UTF8-segment Text concatenation and guarded backward slices in Gooo. Internal CleanState and CleanPart are implementation details, not additional Go APIs.
semantics: Slash paths independent of host OS; empty becomes dot, root clamps parent traversal, leading relative parents remain. Backslash, percent escapes, NUL and Unicode lookalikes are ordinary characters; no Unicode normalization.
verification: Input-only finite fixtures; independent actual Go path.Clean expectations plus fresh current-source native execute and saved replay are required. Source hashes and declarations alone do not establish acceptance.
unsupported: No filepath/Windows semantics, URL decoding, routing identity, symlinks, filesystem effects, permission or safety guarantee.
